en.name: L3Harris F-PANO fused panoramic night vision goggles (FDE)
en.description: Fused Panoramic Night Vision Goggle: the four-tube, 97 degree panoramic goggle with a thermal channel added. Four white phosphor image intensifier tubes; a small thermal camera above the right inner tube lays its picture over that tube's image.

ch.name: L3Harris F-PANO 融合全景夜视仪（沙色）
ch.description: 融合全景夜视仪：在四管、97 度视场的全景夜视仪上加了一路热成像。四支白磷像增强管；右侧内管上方有一台小型热像仪，它的画面叠加在这根管的图像上。
